rules: Exact native menu masks plus an independent whole-stock rank trace and native difficulty HUD. One exact label may be recognized at any position within +/-20 native pixels of the selection center. The translucent fallback stays within +/-6 and requires gradient correlation >=0.68, alternate-label margin >=0.45 and same-position brightness-cut Dice >=0.88.
initial_hud_rule: The opening fade also permits a single brightness cut that reproduces an entire original difficulty glyph exactly.
